payload.title: Within-well multi-cut coefficient dynamics
payload.statement: Four-control spline targets fitted on several observed pseudo-tails inside a well's known prefix form a coefficient trajectory that predicts the well's final hidden-tail nonlinear coefficients and adds stable value to E011.
payload.evidence_for: E010 bank oracle is 4.7511, E011 spline4 oracle is 4.0810, and 90.46% of E010 regret is coefficient estimation/aggregation. Every well has at least 851 known rows, allowing four supported legal pseudo-cut tasks. E011 uses only 15 aggregate backtest summaries, not pseudo-cut coefficient targets.
payload.evidence_against: Pseudo-tail dynamics may not extrapolate across the much longer final hidden suffix; generic smooth movement can pass weak controls, as T023 showed; spatial/typewell transfer may still fail.
payload.next_test: Complete T025 across every frozen analytic, ridge, tree, KNN, comparator, placement, stress, negative-control, and edge-case branch before authorizing a formal experiment.
